acquisition method: MS data were acquired in a data-dependent mode, selecting up to top ten precursors based on precursor abundance in the survey scan
cleavage agent: ESP sample was digested using filter-aided sample preparation with 1 μg of trypsin (sequencing grade, Promega).
instrument: analysed in a mass spectrometer (Orbitrap Elite, Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: Eluted peptides (2 μg) were ionised by a nanospray (PicoView 550 nano source)
labeling: No labeling strategy mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
ptm: oxidation (M) variable; deamidation (N, Q) variable; acetylation (Protein N-term) variable; carbamidomethylation (C) fixed

Modifications for all database searches were set as follows: oxidation (M), deamidation (N, Q), and acetylation (Protein N-term) as variable modifications, with carbamidomethylation (C) as a fixed modification.
